column1: genshin_moonoracle.lore.the_tower.001
=A card box given to you by a certain witch proficient in divination.
column2: 占いに長けたとある魔女から贈られたカードケース。

column1: =It can be used to store the Lunar Arcana you find during your performances,
column2: 演奏の旅で見つけた月のアルカナを収めておける。

column1: =cards which may also be exchanged with friends in Co-Op Mode.
column2: カードはマルチプレイで友人と交換することもできる。

column1: =Each world defines divination differently,
column2: 占いの定義は世界ごとに異なる。

column1: =but one thing remains constant — the use of "here" and "now" as anchors to unravel the unknown.
column2: だが変わらないことがひとつある — 「ここ」と「いま」を錨として、未知を解き明かすことだ。

column1: =Thus, the more Arcana one hoards within this box,
column2: ゆえに、この箱に集めたアルカナが多いほど、

column1: =the brighter the lantern of understanding burns...
column2: 理解の灯火はより明るく燃える…

column1: ="There will come a day, when she too will grow weary,
column2: 「いつの日か、彼女もまた倦むだろう、

column1: =Of singing with the angels on high.
column2: 天上で天使たちと歌うことに。

column1: =When she would prefer to embrace,
column2: 彼女はむしろ抱きしめたいと願う、

column1: =The rotting bones of the mortal world."
column2: 人の世の朽ちた骨を。」

column1: =In Teyvat, such a sentiment is not a faithless criticism,
column2: テイワットにおいて、この想いは不信心な批判ではなく、

column1: =Nor is it hunger for earthly desires.
column2: 俗世の欲への渇望でもない。

column1: =It is merely one from the heavens,
column2: それはただ、天上の者が

column1: =Desiring to witness firsthand,
column2: 自らの目で見届けたいと願っただけ。

column1: =The creatures of the world,
column2: この世界の生き物たちの、

column1: =Their lives,
column2: その生を、

column1: =Their deaths —
column2: その死を —

column1: =It is simply a comment on this, and nothing more.
column2: それについての感想にすぎず、それ以上のものではない。

column1: =Blades, spears, swords, and pikes, eight thousand ranks deep, armored steeds and weapons of war, one hundred thousand strong.
column2: 刃、槍、剣、矛、八千の隊列。鎧の軍馬と兵器、十万の軍勢。

column1: =They say the road to the terraced spring is far, the blossoms ever changing.
column2: 段々の泉へ至る道は遠く、花は移ろい続けるという。

column1: =Awaiting the spring breeze to scatter,
column2: 春風が吹き散らすのを待つ、

column1: =The thin night mist.
column2: 薄い夜霧を。

column1: =Friends,
column2: 友よ、

column1: =Returned now from the nether realm,
column2: 冥府から今ここへ還り、

column1: =To see what form this illusory world displays.
column2: この幻の世がいかなる姿を見せるか見届けよ。

column1: =The underworld's court has yet to pass "Judgment," the "eternal calamity" remains unchanged.
column2: 冥界の法廷はいまだ「審判」を下さず、「永劫の災い」は変わらぬまま。

column1: =Alas, this is not the world of old,
column2: ああ、ここはもう昔の世界ではない、

column1: =The hearts of the past can no longer be found.
column2: かつての心はもう見つからない。

column1: =Only our names remain,
column2: 残るは我らの名のみ、

column1: =Inked into illustrious record, a hundred ghosts in a painting.
column2: 輝かしき記録に墨で記された、絵の中の百の亡霊。

column1: =The laws that now bind the nations of the world,
column2: いま世界の国々を縛る法は、

column1: =Without exception, derive from the will of gods or mortals.
column2: 例外なく、神か人の意志に由来する。

column1: =As with these laws, when we speak of "Justice,"
column2: 法と同じく、我らが「正義」を語るとき、

column1: =We are speaking of a concept that was not born from nature.
column2: それは自然から生まれたのではない概念を語っている。

column1: =A construct of nations and peoples, a meaning devoid of purpose.
column2: 国と民が作り上げたもの、目的なき意味。

column1: =What is justice?
column2: 正義とは何か？

column1: =Mercy, the authority of creation, form for the formless,
column2: 慈悲、創造の権能、形なきものに与える形。

column1: =Harmony, perfect elevation, a balancing hand on uneven scales,
column2: 調和、完全なる昇華、傾いた天秤を均す手。

column1: =Revenge, armed retribution, a dream of the old epoch's downfall,
column2: 復讐、武力による報い、旧き時代の没落の夢。

column1: =A drama, a dreaming delusion, a neverending cycle of sacrifice,
column2: 歌劇、夢見る妄想、終わりなき犠牲の循環。

column1: =Mystery, death and rebirth, the lonely chill of salvation.
column2: 神秘、死と再生、救済の孤独な冷たさ。

column1: =Yet so you shall say:
column2: それでも、汝はこう言うだろう:

column1: ="To submit to love without any flaw of will — this is the shadow of primordial justice."
column2: 「一片の意志の欠けもなく愛に身を委ねる — これこそ原初の正義の影である。」

column1: =The renewal of the second cycle,
column2: 第二の循環の再生、

column1: =The reversal of servant and served.
column2: 仕える者と仕えられる者の逆転。

column1: =Matters deduced a priori, etched into the bloodlines of new life,
column2: 先験的に導かれ、新たな命の血脈に刻まれたもの、

column1: ="Strength," passed down for a thousand years, and the sin it births.
column2: 千年受け継がれた「力」と、それが生む罪。

column1: =The tyrant steeped in blood,
column2: 血に染まった暴君、

column1: =The oppressed, too, steeped in blood,
column2: 虐げられた者もまた血に染まり、

column1: =The circle of history eternally repeating,
column2: 歴史の輪は永遠に繰り返し、

column1: =Replayed again in the embryonic record.
column2: 胚の記録の中で再び演じられる。

column1: =Praise, praise, the lord of the flaming wings!
column2: 讃えよ、讃えよ、炎の翼の主を！

column1: =Praise, praise, the empire immortal!
column2: 讃えよ、讃えよ、不滅の帝国を！

column1: =Praise, praise, the radiant alliance!
column2: 讃えよ、讃えよ、輝ける同盟を！

column1: =And praise, praise, the glorious endeavor of the sun!
column2: そして讃えよ、讃えよ、太陽の栄光なる偉業を！

column1: =And so, a new yet ancient era,
column2: かくして、新しくも古き時代が、

column1: =As countless millennia before, unfolds its prelude.
column2: 幾千年もの昔と同じく、その序章を開く。

column1: =The path from the moon to the sun,
column2: 月から太陽へ至る道、

column1: =Its mysteries inexpressible by words.
column2: その神秘は言葉では言い表せない。

column1: =Don't allow desire to dictate your actions,
column2: 欲望に行いを支配させてはならない、

column1: =This is but the shallowest meaning of "Temperance."
column2: それは「節制」の最も浅い意味にすぎない。

column1: =You exercise great "artistry,"
column2: 汝は偉大なる「技芸」を振るう、

column1: =Sand does not dissolve in water,
column2: 砂は水に溶けない、

column1: =Yet it must be sifted out.
column2: それでも、ふるい分けねばならない。

column1: =Golden dreams do not reveal themselves in reality,
column2: 黄金の夢は現実に姿を現さない、

column1: =Yet you must unite them into one.
column2: それでも、ひとつに結び合わせねばならない。

column1: =The unchanging desert,
column2: 変わらぬ砂漠、

column1: =The ancient structures fallen into disrepair.
column2: 荒れ果てた古の建造物。

column1: =Can you still recall the dreams of old?
column2: 汝はまだ昔の夢を思い出せるか？

column1: =The fables of ibis, crocodile, and jackal,
column2: トキ、ワニ、ジャッカルの寓話、

column1: =The principles of balance.
column2: 均衡の原理を。

column1: =The golden drums split the clouds, banners unfurled across mountains.
column2: 黄金の太鼓は雲を裂き、旗は山々にひるがえる。

column1: =Waves break on the cliffs as wind sweeps the ramparts, iron crossbows strung by the moon.
column2: 波は崖に砕け、風は城壁を払い、鉄の弩は月明かりに弦を張る。

column1: =The "Chariot" holds the narrow pass.
column2: 「戦車」は狭き峠を守る。

column1: =No fear for the dayless abyss, but sorrow felt for the stove fires in the streets.
column2: 日なき深淵を恐れず、ただ街のかまどの火を想って悲しむ。

column1: =A thousand dangers cannot halt our tireless march to bring peace to the homeland.
column2: 千の危難も、故郷に平和をもたらす我らのたゆまぬ行軍を止められない。

column1: =A thousand mountains guard the city walls.
column2: 千の山が城壁を守る。

column1: =Was there ever a true age of darkness?
column2: 真の暗黒時代など、かつてあっただろうか？

column1: =Where ignorance and shadow were mistaken for divine,
column2: 無知と影が神聖と取り違えられ、

column1: =And the "Devil" was hailed as creator.
column2: 「悪魔」が創造主と讃えられた時代が。

column1: =Where violence and suffering ran rampant,
column2: 暴力と苦しみがはびこり、

column1: =A "Dark Age" of savagery that burned through civilization.
column2: 野蛮が文明を焼き尽くした「暗黒時代」が。

column1: =The "Devil" is merely a mask,
column2: 「悪魔」はただの仮面にすぎず、

column1: =Through which the power of darkness is revealed.
column2: それを通して闇の力が現れる。

column1: =The god who creates and maintains,
column2: 創り、保つ神、

column1: =The abyss that consumes and destroys.
column2: 呑み込み、滅ぼす深淵。

column1: =That infinite, boundless, perpetual "Age of Enlightenment."
column2: あの無限で、果てなく、永遠の「啓蒙の時代」。

column1: =Among the countless worlds, innumerable gods and mortals,
column2: 数え切れぬ世界の中で、無数の神と人が、

column1: =Seek power for themselves for myriad reasons.
column2: さまざまな理由で自らのための力を求める。

column1: =Passion, pleasure, joy, and hope,
column2: 情熱、快楽、喜び、希望、

column1: =Sin, blood, beneficence, and duty,
column2: 罪、血、慈善、義務、

column1: =Burning love and rising desire,
column2: 燃える愛と高まる欲望、

column1: =In the end, beneath the unyielding, absolute will of the self,
column2: 結局は、揺るがぬ絶対的な自我の意志のもとで、

column1: =All serve to conceal, to crystallize, and to reshape that which is soft and mutable.
column2: すべては柔らかく移ろうものを覆い隠し、結晶させ、作り変えるためにある。

column1: =Such symbolism cannot be found in the divination cards of this world,
column2: そのような象徴は、この世界の占いカードには見当たらない。

column1: =For since the very beginning, only one ruler has controlled the countless kingdoms that have arisen.
column2: なぜなら最初から、興った無数の王国を治めてきたのはただ一人の支配者だけだからだ。

column1: =They are the "Emperor" who slumbers within their eggshell,
column2: それは卵の殻の中で眠る「皇帝」、

column1: =Yet proclaims themselves undying.
column2: それでいて自らを不死と称する者。

column1: =Before the ink dries, the kingdom lies yet unbirthed,
column2: 墨が乾く前、王国はまだ生まれていない、

column1: =Once the final stroke falls, the world is completed.
column2: 最後の一筆が落ちれば、世界は完成する。

column1: =When all is done, no matter how wise, no matter how earnest,
column2: すべてが終われば、どれほど賢くとも、どれほど真摯でも、

column1: =When tears run dry, nothing shall change her.
column2: 涙が涸れたとき、何者も彼女を変えられない。

column1: =The path between spirit and love,
column2: 魂と愛のあいだの道、

column1: =Nurturing illusions and metaphor,
column2: 幻想と隠喩を育む、

column1: =The "Empress" of portents and quicksilver,
column2: 前兆と水銀の「女帝」、

column1: =From the soil where the seeds of imagination slumber,
column2: 想像の種が眠る土から、

column1: =Where the tales of countless lives take root.
column2: 無数の命の物語が根を下ろす。

column1: =The boar is crowned a princess,
column2: イノシシは姫の冠を戴き、

column1: =Fantasy is hailed as truth.
column2: 空想は真実と讃えられる。

column1: =Wolves, squirrels, turtles, and pygmies,
column2: オオカミ、リス、カメ、小人たち、

column1: =Home of the exiled and defiant,
column2: 追放された者と反逆者の故郷、

column1: =A verdant and evergrowing tapestry,
column2: 青々と育ち続けるタペストリー、

column1: =A fable of mortals and those beyond humanity,
column2: 人と人ならざる者の寓話、

column1: =All are stories, offered to your life.
column2: すべては物語、汝の生に捧げられる。

column1: =A drifting star that even the "fortune" that wove the "world" could not imprison.
column2: 「世界」を織りなした「運命」でさえ閉じ込められなかった漂う星。

column1: =To the master of the cage, a path with no design has always been inexcusable folly.
column2: 籠の主にとって、設計なき道は常に許しがたい愚行であった。

column1: ="I am the void at the moment of creation, I am the newborn spark when all things end."
column2: 「我は創造の瞬間の虚無、万物が終わるときに生まれる火花。」

column1: ="My traveling pack is empty, I have only this pure-white companion by my side."
column2: 「旅の荷は空っぽ、傍らにはこの真っ白な相棒がいるだけ。」

column1: ="I will mock all desire, glory, and reason, I will tread the seven-fold steps."
column2: 「我はあらゆる欲望、栄光、理性を嘲り、七重の階を踏みゆく。」

column1: ="One star rises in the heavens, one star falls in the valley, the two have always been the same."
column2: 「ひとつの星は天に昇り、ひとつの星は谷に落ちる。二つはずっと同じものだった。」

column1: =The opulent light sinks into the dark depths beneath the earth,
column2: 豪奢な光は大地の下の暗い深みへと沈み、

column1: =Seeking to redeem the radiance that is fated to be extinguished.
column2: 消えゆく定めの輝きを贖おうとする。

column1: =Yet "redemption" is a word filled with arrogance,
column2: だが「贖い」とは傲慢に満ちた言葉だ、

column1: =There is an implicit meaning hidden within,
column2: そこには暗黙の意味が隠されている、

column1: =That mortals have done some clear wrong that must be corrected.
column2: 人が何か正すべき明白な過ちを犯したのだと。

column1: =The path where "strength" is sacrificed for "human wisdom",
column2: 「人の知恵」のために「力」を犠牲にする道、

column1: =Is that of the "Hanged Man" who seeks to glimpse the mysteries of the demonic heavens hanging from the white tree.
column2: それは白き木に吊るされ、魔性の天の神秘を垣間見ようとする「吊るされた男」の道。

column1: =Though the intelligence that mortals grasp is flawed,
column2: 人がつかむ知性には欠陥があるが、

column1: =It cannot be said to be false.
column2: 偽りとは言えない。

column1: =Quite the opposite, for reflected in his inverted eyes,
column2: むしろ逆に、彼の逆さまの瞳に映るのは、

column1: =Is a pure truth illuminated beneath infinite brilliance.
column2: 無限の輝きのもとに照らされた純粋な真実なのだ。

column1: =Allow not that knowledge,
column2: その知識に、

column1: =To vainly torment your heart.
column2: いたずらに心を苛ませてはならない。

column1: =All the world's magnificence and perfection,
column2: 世界のあらゆる壮麗さと完璧さも、

column1: =Will eventually fade, like sand slipping through cracks in your fingers.
column2: いずれは指の隙間からこぼれる砂のように消えていく。

column1: =Tulaytullah's sapphire domes,
column2: トゥライトゥラのサファイアの丸屋根、

column1: =The steeds of Iab and gold of Unut,
column2: イアブの駿馬とウヌトの黄金、

column1: =The beauties of Shimti and the nightingales who sang day and night,
column2: シムティの美女たちと昼夜歌い続けた小夜啼鳥、

column1: =All glory and splendor have vanished unseen.
column2: すべての栄光と華やかさは人知れず消え去った。

column1: =Seek not the secrets of the world for the sake of empty renown,
column2: むなしい名声のために世界の秘密を求めるな、

column1: =For who can unravel the marvels wrought by the Lord of the Sky?
column2: 天空の主が成した驚異を、誰が解き明かせようか？

column1: =This is the path from love to beauty.
column2: これが愛から美へ至る道。

column1: =Only the "Hermit"'s lantern burns ever brightly.
column2: ただ「隠者」のランタンだけが明るく燃え続ける。

column1: =Do you remember the ancient words —
column2: 覚えているだろうか、古の言葉を —

column1: =Where love and lamplight meant the same thing?
column2: 愛と灯火が同じ意味だった頃を？

column1: =Give your love to everyone,
column2: すべての人に愛を捧げよ、

column1: =While the years still allow it.
column2: 歳月がまだそれを許すうちに。

column1: =The "Hierophant" sings the rites of revelation,
column2: 「教皇」は啓示の儀式を歌い、

column1: =The grand cathedral opens its doors to all life.
column2: 大聖堂はすべての命に扉を開く。

column1: =But the god who is praised,
column2: だが讃えられる神も、

column1: =The sentinel who holds the key,
column2: 鍵を握る番人も、

column1: =Is akin to the children of the mortal world,
column2: 人の世の子らと同じく、

column1: =Powerless to speak of the mysteries of heaven.
column2: 天の神秘を語る力を持たない。

column1: =How should one describe a wind without form?
column2: 形なき風をどう言い表せばよいのか？

column1: =How should one recite a poem without words?
column2: 言葉なき詩をどう詠めばよいのか？

column1: =It matters little, for faith is meaning in itself,
column2: それは大した問題ではない。信仰はそれ自体が意味なのだから、

column1: =People need something to believe.
column2: 人は何かを信じる必要がある。

column1: =Flowers, bearing fruit, new life born from crystal,
column2: 花、実を結び、結晶から生まれる新たな命、

column1: =The truths people yearn for, forever hidden within form.
column2: 人が焦がれる真実は、永遠に形の内に隠されている。

column1: =A "High Priestess" seated behind a veil of mystery,
column2: 神秘のヴェールの奥に座す「女教皇」、

column1: =A crowned beauty, lost in false deeds,
column2: 偽りの行いに迷う、冠を戴いた美女、

column1: =Walking the "transcendant" path through the pillars' midst,
column2: 柱のあいだを抜ける「超越」の道を歩む、

column1: =In the end, what does your "heart" seek?
column2: 結局のところ、汝の「心」は何を求めるのか？

column1: =The path to understanding and beauty,
column2: 理解と美へ至る道、

column1: =Love, or the smelting and separation that signify it.
column2: 愛、あるいはそれを示す精錬と分離。

column1: =The clumsy speech of the mundane world cannot describe such opaque mysteries,
column2: 俗世の拙い言葉ではそのような不透明な神秘を語れない、

column1: =And so it calls them "Lovers."
column2: だからそれを「恋人」と呼ぶ。

column1: =The joy of new life and intertwined souls,
column2: 新たな命と絡み合う魂の喜び、

column1: =A fated encounter doomed to be broken.
column2: 引き裂かれる運命にある宿命の出会い。

column1: =And so —
column2: だから —

column1: =Dance now, dance,
column2: さあ踊ろう、踊ろう、

column1: =O "Lover" mine alone,
column2: ああ、私だけの「恋人」よ、

column1: =My inseparable "other half,"
column2: 離れられない私の「片割れ」よ、

column1: =For every joy-filled yesterday we once shared,
column2: かつて分かち合った喜びに満ちたすべての昨日のために、

column1: =For every tomorrow we once longed for but will never see.
column2: 焦がれながらも決して訪れないすべての明日のために。

column1: =Dance through the wind and snow, through the trials and our final secret wedding,
column2: 風雪を越え、試練を越え、最後の秘密の婚礼を越えて踊ろう、

column1: =Even "death" cannot part us.
column2: 「死」でさえ私たちを分かてない。

column1: =Resolve flows like fragrant tea,
column2: 決意は香り高い茶のように流れ、

column1: =Reality shaped by whim and leisure.
column2: 現実は気まぐれとゆとりによって形作られる。

column1: =A cup, a pen, a knife, and a plate of desserts,
column2: 杯、ペン、ナイフ、そしてデザートの皿、

column1: =A small, secret rite, a harmony of four humors,
column2: 小さな秘密の儀式、四つの気質の調和、

column1: =The bustle of an afternoon that stirs fond memories.
column2: 懐かしい記憶を呼び起こす午後のにぎわい。

column1: =You claim that all resides in you,
column2: 汝はすべてが自分の内にあると言う、

column1: =Yet, in the end,
column2: だが、結局のところ、

column1: =That fleeting moment of laughter and "magic,"
column2: 笑いと「魔法」のあのつかの間のひとときは、

column1: =Is naught but a speck of light,
column2: ほんの一点の光にすぎない、

column1: =Formed in the boundless void.
column2: 果てしない虚空に生まれた。

column1: =When we speak of the "Moon" in astrology,
column2: 占星術で「月」を語るとき、

column1: =We must understand that the phases of the moon are symbols and metaphors,
column2: 月の満ち欠けは象徴であり隠喩であると理解せねばならない。

column1: =False tranquility, shattered destruction, and in between,
column2: 偽りの静けさ、砕けた破滅、そしてそのあいだにある、

column1: =The power to transform the world.
column2: 世界を変える力。

column1: =When we speak of the "Moon" in the divination cards,
column2: 占いカードで「月」を語るとき、

column1: =We must know that it is an abstraction of the old world and the spiritual one.
column2: それが旧き世界と霊的な世界の抽象であると知らねばならない。

column1: =The ruler of the moon, the lord of the world of night,
column2: 月の支配者、夜の世界の主、

column1: =The medium between the surface and the universe,
column2: 地表と宇宙をつなぐ媒介、

column1: =The ruler of the spiritual world.
column2: 霊的な世界の支配者。

column1: =The tides, the axis of life,
column2: 潮、命の軸、

column1: =The calendar of sun and moon,
column2: 太陽と月の暦、

column1: =The master of water, night, and the underworld.
column2: 水と夜と冥界の主。

column1: =Now, only ruins remain,
column2: 今は廃墟だけが残り、

column1: =Wordlessly gazing at the homeland to which mundane matter has not returned.
column2: 俗なる物質が還らなかった故郷を、言葉なく見つめている。

column1: =Among the divination cards, the "Star" has a deep connection with water.
column2: 占いカードの中で、「星」は水と深いつながりを持つ。

column1: =The astrological water carrier, missing from this world,
column2: この世界から失われた、占星術の水瓶を運ぶ者、

column1: =A star of hope, poured into water.
column2: 水に注がれた希望の星。

column1: =And that is why hydromancy holds legitimacy!
column2: だからこそ水占いには正当性があるのだ！

column1: =In principle, in this world,
column2: 原則として、この世界では、

column1: =The "Sun" seldom refers to a specific star in tomes of philosophy or mystery.
column2: 哲学や神秘の書で「太陽」が特定の星を指すことはまれである。

column1: =So, what do we mean when we speak of the "Sun"?
column2: では、「太陽」を語るとき、我らは何を意味しているのか？

column1: =Wings spread over all, the earliest, most brilliant light.
column2: すべてを覆う翼、最初にして最も輝かしい光。

column1: =The shared story of the countless stars in the universe.
column2: 宇宙の無数の星が分かち合う物語。

column1: =The direction of a soul's ascension in the spiritual world.
column2: 霊的な世界で魂が昇っていく方向。

column1: =And everything blessed by the grace of light and heat,
column2: そして光と熱の恵みに祝福されたすべてのもの、

column1: =All that grows, and all ideals.
column2: 育つすべてのもの、すべての理想。

column1: =Those who come bearing welcome round the mountain slope in single file,
column2: 歓迎を携えて来る者たちが、一列になって山の斜面を回り、

column1: =To witness,
column2: 見届けるために、

column1: =The final scene of my life,
column2: 我が生涯の最後の場面を、

column1: =One more searing page.
column2: もう一枚の焼けつくようなページを。

column1: =I stop, taking in their faces,
column2: 我は立ち止まり、彼らの顔を見渡す、

column1: =Certain that I know each one.
column2: 一人ひとりを知っていると確信して。

column1: =A fearless cry rises from my lips,
column2: 恐れなき叫びが唇からほとばしる、

column1: ="Master Roland, who seeks the dark 'Tower,'
column2: 「闇の『塔』を求めるローランド殿が、

column1: =Has come before it."
column2: その前に来たれり。」

column1: =You may have heard it say:
column2: 汝はそれがこう言うのを聞いたかもしれない:

column1: ="My work is complete."
column2: 「我が業は成った。」

column1: =The golden lion bows its head,
column2: 黄金の獅子は頭を垂れ、

column1: =And the silver tree sprouts buds.
column2: 銀の木は芽吹く。

column1: =Following all that is remembered,
column2: 記憶されたすべてに従い、

column1: =The "World" stands firm.
column2: 「世界」は揺るがず立つ。

column1: =You have not heard it say:
column2: 汝はそれがこう言うのを聞いていない:

column1: =And thereafter create nothing more.
column2: そしてその後、もう何も創らなかったと。

column1: =The earth and mountains lie silent,
column2: 大地と山は沈黙し、

column1: =While the waters and rain gently murmur.
column2: 水と雨はやさしくささやく。

column1: =The flames crackle,
column2: 炎はぱちぱちと爆ぜ、

column1: =While the winds blow wordlessly by.
column2: 風は言葉なく吹き過ぎる。

column1: ="Memory" is "design,"
column2: 「記憶」は「設計」であり、

column1: =The scales are a symbol of reason.
column2: 天秤は理性の象徴である。

column1: =The golden twins join hands,
column2: 黄金の双子は手を取り合い、

column1: =You follow each tiny piece of your memory,
column2: 汝は記憶の小さなかけら一つひとつをたどり、

column1: =The "universe" stands firm.
column2: 「宇宙」は揺るがず立つ。

column1: =You say:
column2: 汝は言う:

column1: =Though there is no meaning in this world within an eggshell,
column2: 卵の殻の中のこの世界に意味はないが、

column1: =The "fortune" we speak of is not some false metaphor,
column2: 我らの語る「運命」は偽りの隠喩ではない、

column1: =In 14 billion "years" of darkness,
column2: 140億「年」の闇の中で、

column1: =It is the sum of all that is destined to happen and all that never will.
column2: それは起こるべく定められたすべてと、決して起こらないすべての総和である。

column1: =Partings, encounters, and partings once more,
column2: 別れ、出会い、そしてまた別れ、

column1: =Birth, destruction, and birth yet again,
column2: 誕生、破滅、そしてまた誕生、

column1: =In the darkness of 93 billion "years" of light,
column2: 930億「光年」の闇の中で、

column1: =All existence holds meaning unknown to any,
column2: すべての存在は誰も知らぬ意味を持つ、

column1: =Without which this universe would seem too solitary.
column2: それがなければ、この宇宙はあまりに孤独に見えるだろう。

column1: =This is the "fortune" that divination cards speak of,
column2: これが占いカードの語る「運命」、

column1: =Or that which cannot be spoken.
column2: あるいは語りえぬもの。

column1: =The "Wheel of Fortune" turns ever onwards,
column2: 「運命の輪」は回り続ける、

column1: =But there are things which are never forgotten,
column2: だが決して忘れられないものがある、

column1: =Things that can never be destroyed.
column2: 決して壊されないものがある。

column1: =At least, I am willing to believe so.
column2: 少なくとも、私はそう信じたい。

column1: =Just as you believe in reunion with her.
column2: 汝が彼女との再会を信じているように。
